## Ctx.handleSessionCaptionArgsVoice() method

Optional `handleSessionCaptionArgsVoice` route handler declaration.

**Signature:**

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

## Remarks

Executed on `voice` updates while the session is active. Routing id=1 (session) runs BEFORE static/intent matching (id=2-3): it reads `ctx.getSession().method` — set via [Ctx.setSessionCaptionArgsVoice()](./gramstax.ctx.setsessioncaptionargsvoice.md) which wires [Ctx.methodSessionCaptionArgsVoice()](./gramstax.ctx.methodsessioncaptionargsvoice.md) — and dispatches this handler through `new Page(ctx)`<!-- -->. When no session is active, the same update falls through to the non-session route [Ctx.handleCaptionArgsVoice()](./gramstax.ctx.handlecaptionargsvoice.md) instead.
